verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail is a SaaS with a web app and API, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, or tracking controls. The option to have mail shipped unopened rather than scanned is a different control (mail handling), not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
